title: The Eagle, the Cat, and the Wild Sow
author: Aesop (trans. V. S. Vernon Jones)
summary: 猫挑拨老鹰和野猪互相提防，最后坐收渔利。
publicDomainBasis: Aesop's fables are ancient; this translation by V. S. Vernon Jones was published in 1912. Public domain in the United States and in China.

paragraphs.en: An Eagle built her nest at the top of a high tree; a Cat with her family occupied a hollow in the trunk halfway down; and a Wild Sow and her young took up their quarters at the foot. They might have got on very well as neighbours had it not been for the evil cunning of the Cat.
paragraphs.zh: 一只老鹰在高树顶上筑巢；一只猫带着孩子占据了树干中段的一个树洞；一头野母猪和她的幼崽则在树根处安了家。要不是猫心怀鬼胎、狡猾多端，她们本可以相处得很好。

paragraphs.en: Climbing up to the Eagle's nest she said to the Eagle, "You and I are in the greatest possible danger. That dreadful creature, the Sow, who is always to be seen grubbing away at the foot of the tree, means to uproot it, that she may devour your family and mine at her ease." Having thus driven the Eagle almost out of her senses with terror, the Cat climbed down the tree, and said to the Sow, "I must warn you against that dreadful bird, the Eagle. She is only waiting her chance to fly down and carry off one of your little pigs when you take them out, to feed her brood with." She succeeded in frightening the Sow as much as the Eagle.
paragraphs.zh: 猫爬上鹰巢，对老鹰说：“你和我都面临着极大的危险。那头可怕的母猪，总在树根那儿拱来拱去，她打算把树连根拔起，好从容地吃掉你一家和我一家。”把老鹰吓得几乎失去理智后，猫又爬下树，对母猪说：“我必须提醒你提防那只可怕的老鹰。她只等着机会，等你带小猪出去时，飞下来叼走一只，喂她的雏鹰。”她把母猪也吓得和老鹰一样厉害。

paragraphs.en: Then she returned to her hole in the trunk, from which, feigning to be afraid, she never came forth by day. Only by night did she creep out unseen to procure food for her kittens. The Eagle, meanwhile was afraid to stir from her nest, and the Sow dared not leave her home among the roots: so that in time both they and their families perished of hunger, and their dead bodies supplied the Cat with ample food for her growing family.
paragraphs.zh: 然后猫回到树干里的洞中，装出一副害怕的样子，白天从不出来。只有夜里，她才悄悄溜出来，为小猫找食。与此同时，老鹰害怕得不敢离开巢，母猪也不敢离开树根处的家；结果，她们和各自的孩子都饿死了，尸体正好给猫和她日益壮大的家庭提供了充足的食物。
